description: This PHP class `ActivityDetailsReportController` is a part of the OrangeHRM system, specifically within the Time module's Controller namespace. It extends an abstract Vue controller and utilizes traits and services to prepare data for rendering an activity details report component. The class processes incoming HTTP requests to set parameters like date range, project, activity, and inclusion of timesheets by adding properties to a Vue component for the front-end.

classes.name: ActivityDetailsReportController
classes.description: A controller for preparing activity details report data for Vue-based front-end rendering within the OrangeHRM time management module.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares a Vue component by adding properties based on incoming request query parameters such as date range, project, activity, and timesheet inclusion options.
